src.label: Embassy of Nepal, London — taking pets to Nepal

head: Bring a recent health certificate and rabies card, and email the Animal Quarantine Office 72 hours before landing.
lines: The Nepali embassy lists the basic papers: a health certificate issued within 10 days of arrival (valid for 30 days; a new one can also be issued in Nepal) and a rabies vaccination card.

The owner must tell the Animal Quarantine Office in Nepal the arrival time at Kathmandu airport 72 hours ahead, by email with flight details, a passport copy, the health certificate and the rabies card.

An embassy recommendation letter is optional. If you ask for one in London it costs £40.00 with same-day processing, and you apply with the letter, passport copy and pet certificates. The page lists no microchip or titre-test rule; the Animal Quarantine Office can give more information.
